conclusion_cn: 本轮有实际进展的是S2：只把推进版风险上限从1%调到2%，六月净利14.84美元、八月14.28美元（250ms），解除部分最小手数限制；列为下一轮研究主候选，原1%源码／EX5留作回退。两个月仅1／2笔交易，不能认定稳定盈利。S1恢复机制收益改善不一致，保留原1%版；S3、S4、S5、S6保留研究参考；Scalping六月亏63.79美元、最大相对净值回撤15.96%，保留失败对照，未通过跨期盈利检查。全组没有晋级Champion。
conclusion_en: S2 is the useful new research lead: changing only the progress variant risk ceiling from1% to2% admitted previously unaffordable minimum-lot setups, yielding USD14.84 in June and14.28 in August at250ms. It is the next research candidate with the original1% source/EX5 retained for rollback, not stable-profit acceptance: there are only1/2 trades. S1 recovery changes were inconsistent, so retain the1% reference. S3/S4/S5/S6 remain research references. Scalping lost63.79 in June with15.96% maximum relative equityDD; retain the failed reference, not cross-period profitability acceptance. No Champion promotion.

findings.title_cn: S1：恢复规则改善了运作路径，未证明改善策略
findings.title_en: S1: recovery changed exposure, not proven signal improvement
findings.text_cn: 六月新恢复版与旧动态版均为-44.86美元／净值DD46.18美元，没有恢复资格，降到0.5%后仍开出2仓，但多次信号继续受最小手数限制。原1%版六月+49.42、八月+45.24；但六月单笔+58.45，其余26笔合计-9.03，这只是收益集中诊断，不是删掉赢家后的另一套策略成绩。八月250ms新恢复版+80.63，较旧动态多7.30，DD多0.59、显式费用多0.96；差额由7个同setup仓位变化+7.29及新增仓+0.01构成，净PF反降。八月0ms为+53.21，比父版少2.74，DD多2.74、费用多1.65。因此保留原1%参考，不按较漂亮的250ms一场晋级。三场各通过25条MQL政策断言，八月两场实际各恢复一次；六月未恢复，不把断言等同全部实盘故障路径。250ms既有部分退出在新旧版完全相同，是恢复前的成交风险超预算修正，不算恢复收益。

The1% reference returned49.42/45.24 in June/August; its June58.45 winner versus-9.03 from the other26 trades shows concentration, not a counterfactual strategy. At August250ms the new candidate returned80.63, up7.30 with DD+0.59 and explicit costs+0.96: seven shared-setup position-size changes explain+7.29 and one extra position+0.01; netPF decreased. At0ms it returned53.21, down2.74, DD+2.74 and costs+1.65. Retain the1% reference. Each run passed25 policy assertions; each August path restored risk once, June never did. The250ms partial overrun reduction was identical in both versions and preceded recovery; it is not recovery benefit.
